notes.title: Evan's Remains now in Korean!
notes.content: Have any Korean-speaking friends? Tell them they can play Evan's Remains now ;)

notes.title: Evan's Remains 20% off and livestream 5PM EST
notes.content:
Hi everybody

Evan's Remains is now 20% off until the 27th. To help Dysis celebrate the sale we'll also be running a livestream today (the 13th) on the Steam store page, hosted by Bumpy McSquigums from 5PM to 7PM EST. We hope to see you in chat!

notes.title: Chinese added!
notes.content: The game is now playable in Chinese, and we've made numerous bugfixes and tweaks based on your feedback.

notes.title: Mac version is live! And last chance to take advantage of the launch discount!
notes.content:
Evan's Remains is now available on Mac for those who were waiting for it. Have fun ;)
Also, tomorrow ends the first after-launch week, so it's your last chance to take advantage of the launch discount! If you liked the game, please leave a review!

notes.title: Evan's Remains Soundtrack now available for purchase!
notes.content: Now you can get Evan's Remains soundtrack, if you buy it bundled with the game you get a discount!

notes.title: Теперь доступно на Русском!
notes.content:
Отличная новость для наших русскоговорящих друзей -теперь игра полностью поддерживается на русском языке

Just a quick update to let our friends in Russia know that we've added Russian Language support to the full game!

notes.title: Evan's Remains is OUT
notes.content: What are you waiting for? Play it, leave a review! ;)
